dedupe_keys.name: exposure model dataset for colombian residential buildings

description: Exposure model dataset for Colombian residential buildings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Juan C Reyes, Universidad de los Andes (uniandes.edu.co). This project provides a harmonized, block-level exposure dataset for seismic risk assessment in Colombia, focusing on residential buildings across 83 prioritized municipalities. The dataset includes geographic location, structural typology, number of stories, population, and replacement cost, offering a representation of the built environment in areas with significant seismic hazard and population exposure. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-7vc2-fw06. Keywords: Exposure model,  building typology,  residential buildings,  inputs for seismic risk assessment,  Colombia . Published 2025-10-29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
